Introduction to the UI Component Library

Macle develops its own component library to meet developers' richer and personalized application scenarios.

Before using this document, ensure that you have read and understood the Introduction to Customized Components.

Code Download

You can directly download the source code of the Macle component library and add it to the project.

Click the download link to download Macle UI component library source code, and copy the dist directory to your own project.

Using Components

Take the button component as an example. You only need to import the customized component corresponding to the button to the JSON file.

{
  "usingComponents": {
    "maui-button": "/path/to/maui-component/dist/button/index"
  }
}

Then, you can directly use the component in the MAML.

<maui-button type="primary">Button</maui-button>
